card.name: Rule out in diagnostic workups
card.fires_on: The word "rule" or "out" in the phrase "rule out" a diagnosis, especially after a suspected condition. It also fires on a few partway-through anatomy words like medullary and peduncle.

modes.label: Rule out
modes.description: The verb "rule" or the particle "out" when excluding a suspected diagnosis before treatment.
